correctness.rationale: Condition on upper-hemisphere normals and integrate translation offsets. The base interval length 2h sin(theta) contributes pi*r after angular averaging, while apex-only offsets integrate to F_H(h)/2; their ratio gives p=N/(pi*r+N). F_H is strictly convex with F_H=2H^3/(H^2+s^2)^2, and mean support r by Cauchy perimeter formula, so disk uniquely minimizes. Every centrally symmetric planar base has a zonoid representation of generating mass a=pi*r/2; pointwise Jensen bounds its averaged F by the segment, with N+=sqrt(H^2+a^2)-a. Strong Jensen supplies the stated variance bound. Dominated-convergence boundary scaling of rectangles b_H/H->kappa yields the explicit H^2 coefficient, while bounded-below h_B yields fixed-base H^3 expansion. Independently evaluated cone endpoints and normalization at H=0.1,1,3; samples cannot replace arbitrary-convex-body argument.
